en_title: Gorakhpur Chhath Puja 2026: Drone Monitoring and Rescue Teams Planned at Ghats
en_seo_title: Gorakhpur Chhath Puja 2026: Drone Monitoring and Rescue Teams Planned at Ghats
en_body: Gorakhpur police have outlined enhanced arrangements for Chhath Puja 2026 as devotees prepare to visit riverbanks and other water bodies across the district. According to a November 13 report, the plan includes additional police monitoring at busy ghats and markets, with drones proposed for surveillance at sensitive locations. Disaster-response personnel from NDRF, SDRF and PAC are expected to be available near water bodies. Officials are also focusing on crowd movement, safe access, lighting and coordination with local organisers. Fruit markets may see heavier footfall during the festival, making traffic and pedestrian management particularly important. The measures are preparations described by authorities, rather than confirmation that every planned deployment has already taken place. Visitors should follow local instructions and avoid unsafe areas near deep water.
